post.content:
As evening settles over the shop, we’re reminded tomorrow is another day—and there’s plenty coming up.

Thursday, August 6

• Tarot with Adie
  12:00 PM–5:00 PM
  https://shopsacredground.com/book/adie/

• Tai Chi Gung with Sherry Gurley
  12:00 PM–1:00 PM
  https://shopsacredground.com/sherry/

• Quantum Alignment Series- Light Codes, Sound Frequencies & Light Language With Eve
  7:00 PM–9:00 PM
  https://shopsacredground.com/book/eve-quantum-class/

Friday, August 7

• The Reflexology Reset: Restorative Wellness w/ Cheryl
  11:00 AM–3:00 PM
  https://shopsacredground.com/cheryl-2/

• Keeper of the Cards: Robert
  1:00 PM–6:30 PM
  https://shopsacredground.com/book/robert/

Saturday, August 8

• Tarot with Adie
  11:00 AM–3:00 PM
  https://shopsacredground.com/book/adie/

• Shaman Medium Melissa
  11:00 AM–2:00 PM
  https://shopsacredground.com/book/melissa/

• Keeper of the Cards: Robert
  3:00 PM–7:30 PM
  https://shopsacredground.com/book/robert/

If you’re not done for the night yet…
Peek at the Observatory — it changes every day.
https://shopsacredground.com/sacred-ground-observatory/

And don’t forget the Library: download a meditation or playlist, find something to watch or listen to, or explore sacred chanting and music.
https://shopsacredground.com/library/

Call to book a session or grab your spot online.
847-749-3922
https://shopsacredground.com/events/

As the night settles, we wish you peace. See you tomorrow.
